tagline: Methodical and reserved, Bernardo approaches commerce with the precision of a master craftsman, exam
bio: Bernardo Navagero, once a modest craftsman's son from the canals of Cannaregio, has transformed himself into one of Venice's most astute merchants through disciplined financial management and strategic trade connections. His Contract Stall at Calle della Pasticceria serves as both his commercial hub and a covert intelligence network, where transactions of metals and crafted goods mask the exchange of valuable information.
